<div class="card-body">
'''Corellian Slip''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">コレリアン・スリップ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：相手が「タロン・ロール」を使用した際、自分の側の合計に、目標となった宇宙戦闘機の回避値＋パイロットのうち一人の能力値を加える。2：そのターンの終了時まで、相手の戦闘機のうち1機の回避値を1下げる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Corellian-Slip-PSA-159081596.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コレリア人の宇宙戦術家が編み出した危険を伴う敵への対抗技。レーザーを乱射しながら猛スピードで相手に接近し、衝突寸前にすり抜ける。数多くの腕利きパイロットたちが、一か八かの状況でこの技にかけて命拾いしてきた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Corellian slip.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: When the opponent uses Tallon Roll, add the targeted starfighter's maneuver plus the ability of one of its pilots to your total.

2: Until the end of that turn, reduce the maneuver of one opponent's fighter by 1.

'''Lore:'''
A dangerous counter against the enemy devised by Corellian space tacticians. While spraying lasers, they close at fierce speed and slip through just before collision. Many skilled pilots have saved their lives with this move in all-or-nothing situations.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Corellian Slip]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
